definitions.explanation: The act of launching a new business venture. Often used in discussions of career paths, economics, and innovation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{起業|きぎょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I started a business with a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{起業|きぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people are starting businesses right after graduating from college.

examples.japanese: {起業|きぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{行動力|こうどうりょく}→行動力：08522_koudouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Starting a business requires not only capital but also strong determination and the ability to take action.

notes:
USAGE:
{起業|きぎょう} focuses on the act of founding or launching a new business. It is commonly used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起業|きぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to start a business
- {起業|きぎょう}{家|か}: entrepreneur
- {起業|きぎょう}⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧: startup capital
- {起業|きぎょう}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: startup support

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ means "company" or "enterprise" (an existing business entity), while {起業|きぎょう} means the act of starting a business. The two are homophones but use different kanji: {企|き} (plan) vs. {起|き} (start).
